entity.firm: Founder Tax Partners is a UK accountancy practice for funded and scaling technology companies. We handle R&D tax relief, SEIS/EIS advance assurance, EMI and share schemes, founder pay and extraction, and investor-ready accounts. Founder Tax Partners is a trading name of Ashfield Trading Ltd, company number 16358723, registered office 20 Ashfield Avenue, Shipley, Bradford, BD18 3AL.
entity.serves: We act for UK founders, funded startups, SaaS companies and scaling technology businesses, from pre-seed through to Series A and beyond.
entity.where: We act for clients across the United Kingdom and work remotely, by phone, video and email.
howItWorks: You tell us your situation through the enquiry form: what stage you are at, what funding you have and what you need looked at.
One of our accountants calls you to go through it and answer the immediate questions.
We agree the scope and the fee before any work starts.
We do the work, deal with HMRC and Companies House on your behalf, and keep you ahead of your deadlines.
entity.next: We reply within 24 hours and one of our accountants comes back to you directly.
